# Wedding Invitation Skill for Muse

Design and generate a wedding invitation in any language through a conversational workflow: it gathers the couple's details and style preferences, then designs a bespoke HTML template from scratch — no template gallery to pick from, every invitation is built for this couple — following a visual vocabulary of 14+ aesthetics with hard design constraints, and renders it locally with headless Chrome into a print-ready PNG. A live tweak panel lets you adjust colors, fonts, frames, and components without rebuilding, and a style picker can produce multiple designs in one session. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: everything runs on your own machine — nothing ever leaves it (the only network call is loading webfonts at preview time); you need Node.js 18+ and a Chromium-family browser for the rendering step. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
